headline: Singapore GP Saturday: Verstappen and Russell headline Sprint under Marina Bay lights
whyCareReason: Verstappen starts on Sprint pole alongside Russell with eight crucial points on offer before main GP Qualifying.
teaser: Verstappen took Sprint pole in 1:31.156. Russell starts second, Leclerc third, and points leader Antonelli seventh.
story: Saturday at the Marina Bay Street Circuit brings double the drama as Formula 1 contests its final Sprint of the 2026 season followed immediately by qualifying for Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix. Max Verstappen lines up on pole for the 100-kilometer dash, flanked by Mercedes driver George Russell who impressed in Friday's single-lap duel. For drivers' championship leader Kimi Antonelli, Saturday poses a critical challenge: starting from seventh on the grid, the Italian prodigy must carve through the congested midfield to safeguard his 84-point championship buffer over Russell before the weekend's main event.
stakes: Russell has an immediate opportunity to cut into Antonelli's 84-point championship lead across Saturday's Sprint and Qualifying.
rivalryAngle: Verstappen and Russell go wheel-to-wheel into Marina Bay's narrow Turn 1 chicane.
funFacts: Marina Bay is hosting an F1 Sprint weekend for the first time in circuit history.
Max Verstappen is hunting his third Sprint victory of the 2026 season.
Mercedes split aerodynamic packages between Russell and Antonelli for this event.

keyPlayers.name: Max Verstappen

keyPlayers.name: George Russell
keyPlayers.hook: Starting on the front row with championship momentum firmly in his sights.
